jobs.occupation: Security Specialist, Vulnerability & Configuration Management
jobs.description:
We are looking for a Security Specialist with broad technical understanding and process minded approach to join our cybersecurity team at JYSK Head Office in Aarhus. You will be responsible for maintaining and developing our Vulnerability Management (VM) & configuration management as well as supporting security initiatives across our infrastructure. If you enjoy tackling complex security challenges and building scalable, secure systems this position is for you.

WHAT WE OFFER YOU

As a Security Specialist, you will join a collaborative team focused on strengthening JYSK’s security while supporting your personal and professional development. You will have the opportunity to learn, grow and work closely with colleagues across IT and the business.

Furthermore, we offer you:

• The chance to work with cutting-edge security technologies in a high-growth retail environment

• A pragmatic, technically driven team where your work has a real impact

• Flexible working conditions and a strong Scandinavian work culture

• A dedicated team committed to IT security and cyber defense

• Training and courses tailored to your development and career growth

WHAT YOUR NEXT JOB WILL BE ABOUT

Your primary responsibility is to maintain and develop our VM & configuration management operations. You will collaborate with infrastructure, application, and network teams, providing technical guidance on vulnerability remediation efforts, configuration best practices and more.

Your tasks and responsibilities in the job include:

• Communicating technical information with technical and non-technical colleagues

• Follow-up on remediation efforts

• Maintaining and improving the vulnerability management program

• Reviewing configurations for security weaknesses and providing remediation guidance

You can read more about our department here.

WHAT SHOULD YOU BRING

We are looking for a new colleague who:

• Has 2+ years of experience working with IT-Security

• Has a solid understanding of security concepts

• Brings experience with Vulnerability Management

• Is fluent in English; Danish proficiency is an advantage

IS THIS YOUR NEXT OPPORTUNITY? Apply today!

If you have any questions regarding the position, please contact Senior security specialist, Rasmus Baj at +45 2849 4190.

We kindly ask you to only attach your CV. With us, there is no need to write a traditional cover letter when applying for a job.

Instead, when you click “I’m interested/Apply”, you will have the option to write a brief message to the hiring team. If you wish, you can use this space to share your motivation for applying or highlight anything else you feel is relevant.

ABOUT US

We believe our employees are key to our success. That is why we strive to offer development and possibilities of growing and finding new challenges within JYSK. Since our founder, Lars Larsen, opened his first store in Denmark in 1979, JYSK has expanded our global presence with stores and web shops in countries around the world.

Our three fundamental JYSK Values – Tradesman, Colleague and Corporate Spirit – express the behaviour and attitude that we can expect from each other. We trust each other, and we believe in Empowerment and freedom with responsibility. We also take pride in rewarding engagement and a great effort among our employees. With the right attitude, opportunities abound in JYSK.

JYSK wants to include everyone, no matter the age, gender identity, race, sexual orientation, physical or mental ability, ethnicity, and experience. Together, we secure our inclusive culture that encourages, supports, and celebrates the diverse voices of our employees. Because a great mix of minds, talents and unique personalities makes us a stronger team.

For more information, please visit our career page.

Learn how we process your data in our Privacy Policy.

jobs.occupation: Sales & Business Development Manager, Combilent
jobs.description:
Combilent is an entrepreneurial company specializing in the design and manufacture of high-performance solutions in the fields of Land Mobile Radio. Despite employing only 25, Combilent is the preferred supplier of components for critical communication to all the largest OEMs in US and Europe, providing premium and highly advanced components behind communication equipment to first responders such as police and alarm centrals. Being part of the Indutrade Group, a Swedish investment company with a vast network of technical companies, Combilent also benefit from their solid market presence and long-term approach to business, looking to grow organically, providing strong support to the companies in the group. Indutrade is recognized for its focus on sustainable growth and Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) strategies, driving sustainable practices across its portfolio of businesses. We are located in Farum, north of Copenhagen and are looking for a:

Sales & Business Development Manager

Business Development – Driving New Business

Combilent has had a solid and profitable business within Land Mobile Radio (LMR) for more than 20 years, and this remains a strong foundation for the company. However, our growth ambitions go beyond LMR. We have built deep expertise and strong relationships as a niche OEM supplier of mechatronics with integrated software and Radio Frequency (RF) technology  and we now want to leverage this platform to build a second leg of business.

Therefore we target to develop an entirely new customer base of OEMs in sectors following today’s major technology trends, while leveraging our position as a niche OEM supplier.

Your job will be to bring new ideas and business opportunities, and open new doors through networking. We offer startup-up speed in combination with access to funding through our owner, and know-how to execute.

You will report to the CEO and work very closely with her and with the founder (CCO) of the company, who plays a pivotal role regarding products and customers.

Key Responsibilities – Building New Ground

In a small entrepreneurial team there will be good opportunities to shape the role, and you will, among other things, be responsible for:

• Identifying and developing new business beyond our current customer base by building relations with new OEM customers in emerging sectors such as Defense, AI, Drones and IoT and expanding into new verticals with current OEM’s through new networking.

• Generating and testing new business ideas through extensive networking outside our current contacts, translating market trends and macro shifts into concrete opportunities for the Combilent

• Building strong relationships and new networks with key customers and partners to generate leads and close new business

• Staying ahead of market trends, emerging technologies, and customer preferences to inform product development and sales strategy

• Building and presenting business cases for new products and market entries, including go-to-market strategies, and resource needs

• Playing an active role at all levels of the business, from high-level strategic discussions to hands-on sales and operational tasks, reflecting the entrepreneurial spirit of Combilent

What You Bring – A Networker and Idea-Generator

Most likely, you hold a degree in Engineering, Business, MBA or related field. You have 5+ years of experience in sales, business management and/or product development, in an industry that is tech focused. You have a hunter profile and get your energy from finding business opportunities and convert them into business. Furthermore, you are experienced in strategic thinking combined with an entrepreneurial mindset, and with the ability to thrive in a small business environment where everyone contributes.

What We Offer – Room to Build Something New

We offer a compensation package that matches your qualifications, including a pension and a bonus scheme, but just as importantly, we offer exciting professional challenges and a team that values openness and good collaboration as well as a culture, where we treat each other well. You will get a key role in a small, innovative company, providing opportunities to make a significant impact on the future direction of the company. You will get autonomy to shape and lead new business ventures, with the opportunity to influence both product development and acquisition strategies.

Application and contact

The application and selection process will be done in collaboration with Brinch & Partners. If you would like to know more about this opportunity and the company, please feel free to contact Partner Martin Bo Sørensen by phone +45 27847406.

We look forward to receiving your CV as soon as possible through the “Apply” button below.

jobs.occupation: DIRECT ENTRY CAPTAIN E195 (TR/NTR) - ALL BASES
jobs.description:
A Future With SAS

Join SAS as we step confidently into a new era of growth and innovation.

Long known as one of the world’s most punctual, sustainable, and innovative airlines, we are now preparing for our largest summer program ever in 2026, opening new routes across Europe, North America, and Asia.

With a modern fleet of more than 100 aircraft, SAS offers a truly varied and rewarding flying experience. From the unique demands of Nordic winter operations to navigating some of the world’s busiest international airspaces, you’ll enjoy a flying environment that is both challenging and deeply fulfilling.

As SAS continues to expand with up to 55 Embraer E195-E2 aircraft joining our fleet, we are looking for Captains and experienced First Officers ready for command. Join us and be part of the next exciting chapter of this growing, respected, and future focused Scandinavian airline.

What We Offer

• Permanent contract

• Fixed base of your choice in Copenhagen, Oslo, Bergen or Stockholm

• Fully funded type-rating with a 3-year bond

• Starting salary: DKK 67.774 / NOK 72.895 / SEK 69.744 per month (depending on base)

• Flexible roster

• Competitive salary progression

• Additional allowances

• Competitive pension scheme

• Insurance benefits

• 42 days of annual leave

• At least 11 days off each month

• Worldwide staff travel benefits

• Career progression opportunities, including transition to A320, A330, or A350

Requirements

• Unrestricted EASA ATPL (A)

• EASA ATPL(A), CPL(A), or MPL (Non‑Scandinavian EASA licenses accepted, but must be converted before course start)

• Valid Class 1 Medical

• Valid Instrument Rating

• ICAO English Level 5 or 6

• Unrestricted right to live and work in the EU

• Clean criminal record

**

Flight Time Requirements**

• 4,000 total flight hours, including 250 hours as PIC or PICUS

or

• 3,500 total flight hours, including 500 hours as PIC on aircraft with MTOW > 16T

or

• 3,000 total flight hours, including 1,000 hours as PIC on aircraft with MTOW > 16T

All requirements must be fully met, and all licenses valid at the time of application.

Recruitment Process

Application Period

We review applications continuously and may close the posting at short notice. We encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

Reapplying

If you previously applied but were not invited to an assessment, you may apply again at any time.

If you attended an assessment but were not successful, you are welcome to reapply 24 months after the unsuccesful assessment.

Candidates who progress will participate in the following steps:

• Online Interview with a recruiter

• Online Tests (cognitive and personality assessments)

• Assessment Day — group exercises, simulator session, personal interview

• Final Checks — background screening, security interview, and drug/alcohol testing

Each step of the process might be disqualifying.

Shortlisted applicants can expect assessment invitations during spring/summer 2026, with employment beginning in summer/fall 2026.

Questions?

Contact us at pilotrecruitment@sas.dk.

Disclaimer:

SAS may adjust the recruitment process or base availability at any time. Meeting minimum requirements or passing assessments does not guarantee employment.

All offers depend on mandatory background checks, including security interview, drug and alcohol testing, license validation, and employment verification.

Salary levels follow collective agreements and cannot be negotiated. Approved candidates may be placed in a pilot holding pool, and start dates depend on operational needs and training capacity.

SAS, Scandinavia's leading airline since 1946, operates from its principal hub at Copenhagen Airport (CPH), complemented by hubs in Oslo (OSL) and Stockholm (ARN). Our mission is to connect Scandinavia with the world and the world with Scandinavia. Each year, SAS serves more than 25 million passengers and transports 55 tons of cargo to 135 destinations across Europe, the USA, and Asia. With a passionate workforce of over 10,000 colleagues, we collaborate with partners and customers to drive transformative changes in aviation. We are committed to achieving net-zero emissions by 2050, embodying the visionary spirit of our founders: “To move from the old to what is about to come, is the only tradition worth keeping”. Innovation and societal progress are at the heart of everything we do. For more information, visit our website at www.flysas.com or follow us on social media for the latest updates and promotions.

jobs.occupation: E-commerce Manager - consumer brand company (Copenhagen)
jobs.description:
We are looking for an experienced and commercially driven E-commerce Manager to take a central role in developing and growing the digital business of an ambitious Copenhagen-based company with an international footprint.

This is an opportunity for someone who combines strong e-commerce expertise with commercial instinct and a hands-on approach. You will have significant ownership of the company's online business and work closely with colleagues across marketing, brand, creative and commercial functions.

Your focus will be clear: create a strong digital customer experience and turn traffic, data and customer behaviour into profitable growth.

The company operates several established consumer brands and has ambitious plans for further international development. E-commerce and direct-to-consumer are important parts of that journey.
The role
As E-commerce Manager, you will be responsible for the ongoing development and commercial performance of the company's e-commerce platform and digital customer journey.

You will take ownership of the Shopify setup and ensure that the webshop is continuously developed, optimized and commercially activated. The role covers both day-to-day execution and longer-term development, so you should enjoy moving between strategy, analysis and getting things done.

You will work closely with internal stakeholders and external partners and have considerable influence on how the company develops its digital business going forward.
Key responsibilities
• Take overall responsibility for the daily operation, development and optimization of the Shopify ecosystem.
• Drive the commercial performance of the webshop with focus on conversion, average order value, retention and revenue.
• Develop and optimize the digital customer journey across the website, product pages, cart and checkout.
• Manage onsite merchandising, navigation, product presentation and digital content.
• Plan and coordinate product launches, campaigns, promotions and other commercial activities.
• Own the e-commerce calendar and ensure strong execution across relevant functions.
• Use data, customer behaviour and performance insights to identify and implement new growth opportunities.
• Drive CRO initiatives, including testing, UX improvements and ongoing optimization.
• Work closely with marketing, CRM and creative teams to create relevant and high-performing digital experiences.
• Support SEO and ensure strong practices across content, structure and site performance.
• Manage relevant Shopify apps, integrations and external partners and contribute to the continued development of the platform.
• Ensure testing and quality assurance when launching new functionality and digital initiatives.
• Support further international expansion through localized and commercially relevant online experiences.Your profile
You have a strong understanding of what drives a successful e-commerce business and are comfortable taking responsibility for both performance and execution.

You are analytical and data-driven, but you also understand that successful e-commerce is about much more than dashboards and KPIs. You have a good eye for the customer journey, brand experience and commercial opportunities and know how to translate insights into concrete improvements.

You will probably have 4-8 years of experience within e-commerce, digital commerce or online retail, ideally from a consumer-oriented business with a strong brand and an international outlook.

We expect you to have solid hands-on experience with Shopify or a comparable platform and a strong understanding of CRO, UX, merchandising, customer journeys and digital performance.

Experience with analytics, SEO, campaign execution and customer acquisition will also be valuable.

Most importantly, you are proactive, commercially curious and comfortable taking ownership. You enjoy an entrepreneurial environment where decisions can be made quickly and where you have the opportunity to make a visible difference.

You communicate fluently in English. Danish is an advantage but not a requirement.
The opportunity
You will join an ambitious company where digital commerce is an important part of the future growth agenda.

The position offers considerable freedom and responsibility and the opportunity to influence both the day-to-day e-commerce business and its future direction.

You can expect close collaboration with management and colleagues across the organization, short decision-making processes and an environment where good ideas are expected to be turned into action.

The company offers an attractive compensation package as well as strong opportunities for professional and personal development.
Interested?
UnikRecruitment assists with the recruitment process. Applications and inquiries will be handled confidentially, and candidates will be assessed on an ongoing basis. The process will close when the right candidate has been identified.

For further information about the position, please contact Michael Kjærgaard, CEO & Owner, UnikRecruitment, on +45 2222 4000 or by email at mk@unikrecruitment.dk.

jobs.occupation: Internship in Data Science
jobs.description:
Are you looking for an internship that combines personal development and the opportunity to support the green transition through data-based insights? Are you passionate about working hands-on with data? Are you eager to turn your theoretical knowledge into practical and customer-centred solutions?

Here is what the job entails

In the role as our Intern in Data Science, you will participate in various projects while working hands-on with data from our meters and related software, systems, and services. Through data analysis, you will help generate insights that support utilities and contribute to the green transition.

More specifically, you will be:

• Working with geographical, topological, voltage, and energy consumption time series data from distributed electricity meters

• Applying physical modelling, data analysis, and potentially machine learning-based methods to real customer data and business cases

• Exploring how meter data can be used to improve understanding of the opportunities, limitations and challenges of the electricity grid

• Driving your own defined project with continuous sparring and feedback from colleagues

As our intern, you will be enrolled in various projects where your ideas and inputs create real value for customers. Throughout your internship, you will experience development opportunities through regular interaction with skilled colleagues, feedback from stakeholders, and the opportunity to connect theoretical knowledge with practical business and customer challenges.

Meet your future team

With a direct reference to Director, Product Portfolio Management, you will join a dedicated team, currently consisting of 9 dedicated colleagues. Together, we are driven by our mission to help utilities handle increased electrification and the transition to a greener future through smart metering, grid insights, data analysis, and customer-centred solutions. With our diverse backgrounds, we combine deep technical expertise, practical customer understanding, while sharing a strong ambition to show how models and data can create real value. In the team, you will experience a collaborative and curious atmosphere, with room for both predefined projects and your own ideas.

Did you know? We use meter data to solve problems that most people do not even realize exist.

Less about us, more about you

We are looking for a motivated and curious Intern, who is ready to turn theoretical insights into practical solutions involving electricity grids, energy transport, and meter data. You are comfortable sharing your ideas and perspectives, challenging existing ways of working, and collaborating with colleagues across the organisation.

In order to succeed we imagine that you:

• Are studying a degree in physics, engineering, data science, or a related analytical field

• Possess strong theoretical knowledge and an ability to work independently

• Have interest in data analysis, physical modelling, and potentially machine learning-based approaches

• Can apply your analytical mindset to identify new innovative ways of working

As we are an international organisation it is important that you are fluent in English and Danish.

Whilst you may not meet all the qualifications listed above, this is an internship position, and we value curiosity and a willingness to learn just as much as experience. If the role interests you and you are motivated to grow, we encourage you to apply.

We offer more than just an internship

At Kamstrup, your contribution as an intern is highly valued, and we cherish the good colleagueship. Therefore, you will experience an internship with a strong focus on your individual development through challenging tasks, career sparring, voluntary courses, as well as social events and a large network. We are proud, that our internship program has resulted in Studenterhus Aarhus granting us with the Mentor Award, the Internationalization Award, the Jury’s Special Award and the award for East Jutland’s Best Internship.

Besides the best program, we also offer:

• The internship is paid if your place of study allows it

• Multiple internship events and weekly internship lunches

• Employee benefits including a healthy canteen, fitness facilities, in-house dental clinic, hairdresser, and a free health clinic

• An active employee association, that fosters a collaborative and supportive workplace community

Do you want to be a part of Kamstrup?

The applications are reviewed on a continuous basis, but you can expect a response within six weeks. Any details about the internship will be individually agreed upon. However, the internship is expected to run from the beginning of February 2027 until the end of June 2027.

Kamstrup is located in Stilling south of Aarhus, and bus number 200 takes you right to the door. It is a requirement that you can work onsite during the semester.

If you have any questions about the position, please contact Senior Director, Product Management - Electricity, Thomas Dezhkam Kristensen, on phone: +45 89 93 10 00.

jobs.occupation: Specialistläkare i neurolog til Midt- og Vestsjællands hospital Slagelse, Danmark
jobs.description:
Nyinrättad tjänst med inriktning mot akutsjukvård och samarbete med Rigshospitalet

Vi utökar vår specialistläkargrupp vid Midt- og Vestsjællands Hospital i samband med uppbyggnaden av en ny akutneurologisk verksamhet. Du kommer att ha stort professionellt inflytande över vår kommande akutvårdsverksamhet och kommer att ingå i ett nytt, nära samarbete med Rigshospitalet.

Varför ska du välja oss?

• Skapa framtidens akutvård: Du kommer att ha en central roll i uppbyggnaden och lanseringen av vår kommande akutneurologiska verksamhet (exklusive trombolys).

• Nytt samarbete med Rigshospitalet: Samarbetet öppnar dörrar för branschöverskridande samverkan, kunskapsutbyte och forskning. För den som är intresserad finns dessutom möjlighet till attraktiva deltidsanställningar (t.ex. en dag i veckan på RH).

• Nya yrkesområden från och med den 1 januari 2027: Till följd av hälso- och sjukvårdsreformen tar vi över den specialiserade rehabiliteringen från kommunerna, vilket ger spännande möjligheter till yrkesmässig utveckling.

• Utrymme för din subspecialisering: Oavsett om ditt intresse ligger inom MS, rörelsestörningar, huvudvärk, demens, epilepsi eller rehabilitering anpassar vi ramarna så att du kan fördjupa dig inom ditt område.

• En stark forskningsmiljö: Vi fokuserar på multisjuka patienter och har en egen professor i neurologi, vars forskning främst är inriktad på multipel skleros.

Din profil

Du är specialistläkare i neurologi – och är antingen nyutexaminerad och vill utvecklas eller en erfaren kollega som söker nya utmaningar.

Vi tror att du:

• brinner för det tvärvetenskapliga samarbetet och vill bidra till kvaliteten på den nya akutmottagningen

• anser att ett nära professionellt samarbete mellan olika sjukhus är värdefullt

• ser stort värde i klinisk vägledning och handledning av våra yngre läkare

• är beslutsam, flexibel och bidrar aktivt till vår goda arbetsmiljö och vår pionjäranda.

Vardagen och uppgifterna

Vår avdelning tar hand om patienter på huvudfunktionsnivå i Slagelse (sjukhusavdelning för fas II-rehabilitering, främst stroke, samt specialistkliniker) och i Næstved, där vi driver Center for Neurorehabilitering (CNN) som har en regionfunktion.

Dina arbetsuppgifter kommer att omfatta

• arbete vid vår öppenvårdsmottagning, våra specialkliniker eller den tvärvetenskapliga minneskliniken (i samarbete med geriatriker, psykiatriker och neuropsykologer)

• handledning av yngre läkare samt deltagande i det tvärvetenskapliga samarbetet mellan olika kliniker.

• jouransvar: specialistläkarna sköter för närvarande bakjourstjänstgöringen på plats fram till kl. 21.00, varefter de har beredskapsjour från hemmet (primärjour finns på plats dygnet runt).

Om avdelningen

Neurologin ingår i en samlad avdelning (Medicin 3 och Avdelningen för fysioterapi och arbetsterapi), där vi har ett nära och välfungerande samarbete med geriatriken. Vi lägger stor vikt vid yrkesmässigt utbyte inom en läkargrupp som präglas av god kollegial sammanhållning och en vilja att utveckla yrket.

Praktisk information och ansökan

• De sju läkarrollerna: Din ansökan ska förhålla sig konkret till de sju medicinska kompetensområdena och innehålla så utförlig dokumentation som möjligt.

• Intressen: Om du har särskilda önskemål gällande subspecialisering eller är intresserad av en delad tjänst med Rigshospitalet, får du gärna ange detta i din ansökan.

Vill du veta mer?

Du är varmt välkommen att kontakta överläkare Benedikte Wanscher på mobilnummer +45 93 57 62 51 eller via e-post till bewa@regionsjaelland.dk för ett konfidentiellt samtal om tjänsten utan förpliktelser.

Villkor, lön och anställning

Anställningen sker enligt avtalet mellan Danske Regioner och YL/Overlægeforeningen, beroende på vilken tjänst som söks.

Det kan finnas möjligheter till anställning enligt ”skatteordningen for højtlønnede” (innebär att du som utländsk specialist, forskare eller högavlönad får en betydligt lägre och förenklad inkomstskatt i Danmark under en begränsad period) för sökande som uppfyller villkoren för detta. Läs mer här

Tjänsten ska tillsättas så snart som möjligt.

I din ansökan eller ditt CV ska du hänvisa till de sju läkartjänsterna och ange om du söker en tjänst som specialistläkare eller överläkare. Om du har några särskilda intressen eller önskemål angående tjänsten får du gärna beskriva dessa i din ansökan.

Bifoga relevant dokumentation.

Hjälp med flytt och undervisning i danska

Om du vill flytta till Danmark i samband med anställningen erbjuder vi kostnadsfri, professionell hjälp med flytt och bosättning nära sjukhuset eller eventuellt i Köpenhamn. Du får hjälp med allt från att hitta boende till registrering och eventuella medföljande familjemedlemmar.

En viktig del av arbetet som specialistläkare är kommunikationen mellan läkare och patient. För patientsäkerhetens skull kräver därför Region Sjælland att våra specialistläkare ska ha kunskaper i danska språket på en tillfredsställande nivå. Vi tillhandahåller därför en språklärare för privatundervisning så att du så snabbt som möjligt kan kommunicera med dina patienter på en nivå där ni förstår varandra.

Det innebär att vi förväntar oss att du är inställd på att lägga tid på att lära dig danska, både i tal och skrift.

Se mer om vad vi erbjuder i form av hjälp här

Rekryteringsprocessen

När vi har mottagit din ansökan kommer vi att bedöma om dina kvalifikationer matchar det vi söker, och du kommer initialt att bjudas in till en intervju via Teams. Om båda parter är intresserade av att fortsätta dialogen kommer du att bjudas in till ett rekryteringssamtal på sjukhuset, där du får träffa avdelningens ledning och personal samt vår HR- och språkkonsult.

Ansökningstid

Vi kommer att granska ansökningarna till tjänsten löpande, så vänta inte för länge med att ansöka.

Verksamhetsområde

Den 1 januari 2027 slås Region Själland och Region Hovedstaden samman och bildar Region Østdanmark till följd av sjukvårdsreformen. Ditt verksamhetsområde kommer att vara Region Østdanmark, inklusive alla tillhörande organisatoriska enheter.

Läs mer om vad verksamhetsområdet innebär på Region Østdanmarks webbplats.

Om Midt- og Vestsjællands Hospital

På Midt- og Vestsjællands Hospital arbetar vi varje dag för att främja ett hälsosamt liv genom förebyggande åtgärder och behandling inom ramen för en samordnad hälso- och sjukvårdsinsats. Som sjukhus förenar vi psykiatri och somatik. Vårt mål är att patienter och medborgare ska få bra och trygg vård av hög kvalitet.

Som medarbetare blir du en del av ett innovativt, kompetent och organisatoriskt stabilt sjukhus där vi gör skillnad för de människor som behöver oss. Lärande och utveckling är en del av vardagen och sker i professionella sammanhang med ett gemensamt ansvar. Det sker även mellan olika avdelningar.

Midt- og Vestsjællands Hospital betjänar ett upptagningsområde med cirka 230 000 invånare. Vi har 766 vårdplatser och cirka 5 000 anställda fördelade på 20 avdelningar, däribland 16 somatiska och psykiatriska avdelningar.

Vi erbjuder en gedigen forskningsmiljö med 13 professorer och en stark yrkesmässig utbildningsmiljö, där vi varje år välkomnar cirka 2 700 studenter, elever och läkare som deltar i vidareutbildning.

Ansættelsesområde

Region Sjælland og Region Hovedstaden bliver den 1. januar 2027 til Region Østdanmark som følge af sundhedsreformen. Dit ansættelsesområde vil være Region Østdanmark med alle tilhørende organisatoriske enheder.

Læs mere om betydningen af ansættelsesområdet på Region Østdanmarks hjemmeside.

Startløn for overenskomstansatte

Regionen er forpligtet til at oplyse dig om startlønnen for stillingen. Du får oplyst grundløn, centralt fastsatte tillæg og pension i den relevante overenskomst. Udover startlønnen, kan lønnen indeholde eventuelt forhandlede tillæg afhængigt af stillingen, dine erfaringer og kvalifikationer.

Se startlønnen på regionens hjemmeside

Om Midt- og Vestsjællands Hospital

På Midt- og Vestsjællands Hospital arbejder vi hver dag for at fremme det sunde liv ved at forebygge og behandle i en sammenhængende sundhedsindsats. Som hospital forener vi psykiatri og somatik. Vores mål er, at patienter og borgere oplever gode og trygge forløb af høj kvalitet.

Som medarbejder bliver du en del af et nytænkende, fagligt og organisatorisk robust hospital, hvor vi gør en forskel for de mennesker, der har brug for os. Læring og udvikling er en del af hverdagen og sker i fagligt forpligtende fællesskaber. Også på tværs af afdelinger.

Midt- og Vestsjællands Hospital dækker et opland på ca. 230.000 borgere. Vi har 766 sengepladser og er omkring 5.000 ansatte fordelt på 20 afdelinger, herunder 16 somatiske og psykiatriske specialer.

Vi tilbyder et solidt forskningsmiljø med 13 professorer og et stærkt fagligt uddannelsesmiljø, hvor vi hvert år byder cirka 2.700 studerende, elever og læger i videreuddannelsesforløb velkommen.

jobs.occupation: Experienced Hardware Engineer: Lead the integration of the hardware that powers ambitious satellite missions
jobs.description:
We are seeking an experienced Hardware Engineer to drive the integration, technical ownership, and continuous improvement of the hardware platforms that enable GomSpace's satellite missions.

You will join our Satellite Systems Business Unit in Aalborg and play a central role in supporting satellite missions from proposal and electrical design through assembly, integration, testing, and delivery to customers worldwide. You will work closely with hardware designers, systems engineers, AIV engineers, manufacturing teams, and project managers while helping shape the future development of our hardware engineering capabilities.

Your Role

As experienced Hardware Engineer, you will act as the technical lead for the integration of electrical hardware and GomSpace products into satellite platforms.

Your key responsibilities include:

• Own the technical integration of GomSpace products into nanosatellite and microsatellite missions.

• Serve as a product expert for GomSpace hardware platforms, interfaces, functionality, configuration, and performance.

• Drive technical troubleshooting and root-cause analysis during development, integration, testing, and customer projects.

• Lead the integration and verification of new GomSpace products and third-party hardware within satellite platforms.

• Define electrical interface solutions, schematic-level designs, harness concepts, and supporting hardware required for mission integration.

• Coordinate prototyping, validation, documentation, and manufacturing introduction activities for new hardware solutions.

• Provide technical leadership and mentorship to junior and mid-level engineers.

• Support technical decision-making and trade-off analyses across customer programmes and internal developments.

• Contribute to process improvements, engineering standards, and product maturity initiatives across the organisation.

• Support proposal activities and customer discussions by providing credible technical solutions, effort estimates, and engineering input.

• Prepare technical documentation and communicate effectively in English, including technical reports, specifications, procedures, and interactions with international stakeholders.

What Success Looks Like

In the initial phase, success means:

• Becoming a recognised technical expert on GomSpace's hardware portfolio.

• Successfully leading hardware integration activities on active customer missions.

• Resolving complex technical issues through systematic troubleshooting and engineering analysis.

• Building strong working relationships with Satellite Systems HW Team, Products HW Team, AIV, Manufacturing, and Systems Engineering.

• Supporting the growth and development of less experienced engineers.

Over time, you will be recognised as a trusted technical authority for hardware integration and product implementation, driving engineering excellence and helping scale GomSpace's hardware capabilities as our missions and teams continue to grow.

What You Bring

You are an experienced hardware engineer who enjoys solving technically demanding challenges and transforming complex products into reliable space systems.

You likely bring:

• An MSc or BSc in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Mechatronics, Aerospace Engineering, or a related discipline.

• 10+ years of experience in hardware design, hardware integration, electronics development, verification, or systems integration.

• Strong knowledge of digital electronics, embedded hardware, and microcontroller-based systems.

• Experience with hardware communication interfaces and buses, including RS485/-422, CAN, SPI, I²C, USB, Ethernet, Spacewire, or similar.

• Experience in schematic capture and hardware development using tools such as Altium Designer or equivalent.

• Understanding of PCB design principles, EMC-, grounding- and shielding considerations, manufacturing processes, and product industrialisation.

• Experience with electrical integration, harness design, laboratory testing, and troubleshooting.

• Practical understanding of power systems, communication systems, and embedded electronics.

• Experience working with multidisciplinary engineering teams and complex technical projects.

• Knowledge of space systems and ECSS standards would be a strong advantage.

• Experience leading technical activities, mentoring engineers, or coordinating engineering teams would be considered a significant benefit.

Who You Are

You are pragmatic, technically curious, and motivated by solving challenging engineering problems.

You are known for:

• Technical leadership – providing direction and guidance without necessarily having formal authority.

• Systems thinking – understanding how individual hardware components contribute to mission success.

• Problem solving – methodically analysing issues and driving them to resolution.

• Collaboration – building strong relationships across engineering disciplines.

• Ownership – taking responsibility for delivering results.

• Mentorship – helping colleagues develop and grow.

• Customer focus – understanding that engineering excellence is measured by mission success.

• True leadership – setting standards, building trust, and enabling others to perform at their best.

Why Join Us

You will play a key role in delivering some of Europe's most ambitious nanosatellite and microsatellite missions, working at the intersection of product development, systems engineering, and customer delivery.

This position offers the opportunity to influence technical decisions across multiple programmes, shape future hardware capabilities, and grow into broader technical or people leadership responsibilities as both the team and business continue to expand.

Join our mission

We encourage you to send your application in English. Interviews will be conducted on a continuous basis. If you have any questions regarding the position, please do not hesitate to contact:

Kelly Antonini

Systems Engineering and Hardware Manager

klan@gomspace.com

Workplace: Langagervej 6, 9220 Aalborg East, Denmark. Salary and start date will be individually negotiated.

As part of our recruitment process, employment requires you to complete a background check conducted by an authorized third-party provider in accordance with applicable legislation.

We kindly draw your attention to the fact that we do not receive applications and resumes via e-mail or by personal appearance. This is to protect and show consideration for your personal information. Apply for the job by following the link below.

About GomSpace

GomSpace is a globally leading designer, integrator and manufacturer of high-end nano and microsatellites for customers in the academic, government and commercial markets. Our positions of strength include systems integration, small satellite subsystems and advanced miniaturised radio technology. At the core of our mission are our values: Be helpful, communicate openly and frequently, and show true leadership.

Our international team is devoted to understanding our customers’ requirements and delivering high quality. We are listed in Stockholm (GOMX), headquartered in Denmark and have subsidiaries in Sweden, Singapore, France, North America and Luxembourg. We have more than 200 employees servicing customers in more than 60 countries.

Learn more on www.gomspace.com

At GomSpace WE MAKE SPACE YOURS.

Join us in shaping the future of space exploration!

Application deadline:

As soon as possible
